name: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) Test
description: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) is the protein carried on every cholesterol particle that can clog arteries (LDL, VLDL and others), with one ApoB on each. So ApoB counts the harmful particles directly, and it can flag risk that LDL cholesterol alone misses, particularly with high triglycerides, diabetes or metabolic syndrome.
